statement: For every r>=3 and every actual continuous lower section of the full cubic group, its metabelian quotient or the single-rational-cusp marked quotient, the next central lift exists exactly when the unique rational tame corrections z_q=-(Phi_q-q)^(-1)epsilon_q are integral and tend to zero. The error epsilon_q is the actual lifted tame-relation word using the genuine higher Frobenius action and actual Frobenius section value. The continuous localization map identifies the global obstruction with [epsilon_q/q] in the restricted sequence cokernel, retaining inverse-limit obstructions. Every nonempty geometric-conjugacy fiber has the explicit E.41 matrix-cokernel parameter group. At the K-prime2 the degree-three local obstruction module is C3^70 plus C9^24 plus C27^76 plus C81^28, of order3^458. At the rational prime2 the corresponding local obstruction module is C3^36 plus C9^12 plus C27^38 plus C81^14, of order3^230.
notes: The theorem starts from an actual lower section, with its full higher arithmetic action supplied; it does not claim that those data can be recovered from the two toric coordinates or rank-ten linear action alone. The actual Frobenius value lambda(h_q)u(sigma_q) retains E.39 correction words. A global continuous Hall lift gives the central two-cocycle. Its inertia homomorphism gives epsilon/q as the chain-level localization representative. Finite-support null-homotopies are verified uniformly over prolongations before direct limits and derived inverse limits. Finite-level gluing with prescribed inertia leaves only finite unramified choices, proving continuous compatible lifts. Restriction to K detects the Q obstruction because corestriction times restriction is multiplication2. The local degree-three certificate retains invertible transformations modulo729; split eigenvalues64,-32,16,-8 of multiplicities168,128,32,2 give the independent determinant valuation458 and exponent bound3^5. Smith counts0^132,1^70,2^24,3^76,4^28 therefore determine the exact group. Full ramified metabelian and marked classification still requires evaluation of the stated higher Frobenius words for all inputs. The rational-Q2 refinement uses an actual norm-one CM conjugation on the full generalized-Jacobian lattice to elliptic sqrt(-2)*C_E and toric2P. Hensel precision2187 gives the divided gluing block modulo729. Its square agrees with K-Frobenius; the inherited exponent bound3^5 and Smith counts0^230,1^36,2^12,3^38,4^14 give the exact rational local group. Independent split-eigenvalue determinant valuation230 agrees. A independently reran both calculations and audited the completed proof.
